name: Will a garage conversion increase my property value?

mainEntity.name: Will a garage conversion increase my property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-executed garage conversion can significantly increase your property value, especially in competitive real estate markets like those in the East Bay. Adding functional living space, such as an extra bedroom, bathroom, or a rentable ADU, is generally viewed as a valuable upgrade. The return on investment often depends on the quality of the conversion, the functionality of the new space, and its integration with the existing home. Our first-party insight is that homeowners often see a substantial return on investment, particularly when the conversion meets market demands for additional housing or flexible living areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: A high-quality garage conversion can increase property value, particularly if it adds functional living space or a rentable ADU.
